page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with running head at top and page number at upper right; a fragment of the facing left page (cut-off text at the left edge) is visible and is not transcribed as main text.

main_text.p: affirmatur etiam de integro secundum partem.
181 Posito integro perfecto ponuntur omnes ejus partes.
182 Posito integro imperfecto ponuntur omnes partes principales.
184 Sublata parte qualibet, tollitur perfectio integri.
185 Pars quæ dicitur singularis, qua talis, est potius species quam membrum.
187 Ipsa natura generis simpliciter consíderata, sine universalitate, est pars.
190 Genus non existit extra suas species.
191 Genus nihil aliud est quam communis illa natura, quæ variis rebus inest.
192 Quicquid essentiale affirmatur & negatur de genere, affirmatur etiam & negatur de specie.

page.notes: Left-edge fragment of facing page omitted. Some words are smudged (e.g. "consíderata", "universalitate" partly obscured); readings of 187 and 190 are doubtful, "extra" in 189 and "non" in 190 read with uncertainty.
